g.text: The neural module — one encoder, three consumers (feature: neural-rescore)
attends to every other position, so nothing is reusable
across steps. KV caching pays off only for autoregressive
decoding. These types compile, are exported and unit-tested,
but no call site in the crate constructs them.
The only cache on a live path.
Keyed by a 64-bit digest of the text
